description: Ten D054 landscape candidates pinned to native versions and checksums; five repaired candidate versions are pending targeted independent review after truthful producer inspection.
review_notice: Unapproved D054 landscape candidates for reference comparison only. Producer reviews are recorded. Stanzas 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 have targeted repairs awaiting independent exact-checksum re-review; the producer findings and measured residual deviations remain disclosed in candidate_status. Stanzas 2 and 8 passed independent review. Stanzas 7, 9 and 10 retain their independently failed versions while generation is paused until the stated reset. Numbered photos #1–#10 map by caption; #2, #7, #9 and #10 have substantial photo/caption or scene mismatches. The three uncaptained nostanza images are Tamil text pages and are unused. Portrait production is paused. This is not art approval and does not change art/approved/.
visual_review_status: Producer reviews of repaired versions for stanzas 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are recorded; targeted independent exact-checksum re-review is pending. Independent reviews remain for the other selected versions. Stanzas 7, 9 and 10 await their authorized targeted repair after the ImageGen reset. No art approval.

rows.scene: Saubhari sits in meditation beneath the clear surface of the Kalindi, with a small fish shoal nearby; Garuda appears overhead at the riverbank, seen by the sage. Keep the underwater and surface layers legible within one continuous landscape scene. No split collage.
rows.candidate_status: Saubhari chest R−B 119 still looks orange-ochre despite numerical proximity to the guide; Garuda feather-arm R−B 109 and simple ochre clothing now fit. Producer needs-fix; targeted independent re-review pending.

rows.scene: At the river surface, Garuda takes one fish from the water as Saubhari watches from below or the bank and raises a restrained hand in a spoken curse. A few fish remain in the water; avoid graphic injury.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Saubhari curse gesture has one index finger extended, three curled fingers and a thumb; the fish-taking and curse scene follows the stanza absent from the photo. Saubhari face/chest R−B 102/111. Garuda feather fields are not exposed skin. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no art approval.

rows.scene: Garuda drives the proud hooded Kaliya toward the dark waters of Kalindi. Show one continuous serpent body entering the river, with Garuda’s two wings clearly attached. A small ritual offering remains on the bank as context for the cause.
rows.candidate_status: Garuda crown, layered jewelry and jeweled waist ornament removed; simple ochre cloth remains. Garuda has two attached wings and two arms; six Kaliya hoods join one body. Producer pass; targeted independent re-review pending.

rows.scene: A poisoned stretch of Kalindi damages the riverbank: two clearly separate dried trees, a few birds falling toward the ground, and one youthful Krishna watching with compassion from the bank. Do not show Kaliya or a physical poison cloud, halo, or light rays.
rows.candidate_status: Krishna face B−R 41; extra jewelry removed; near foot five toes, far side-on foot only four clear toe outlines. Producer needs-fix; targeted independent re-review pending.

rows.scene: On a very hot day, young Krishna has entered the Yamuna forest without Balarama. Thirsty cowherds and a modest herd drink from the poisoned river; Krishna is present but does not drink. Show a calm, non-graphic warning moment before collapse.
rows.candidate_status: Krishna face B−R 44 and jewelry removed; gopa skin patches R−B 110, 139 and 133, with center/right still orange-rust. Producer needs-fix; targeted independent re-review pending.

rows.scene: Krishna comes close to the fallen cowherds and cows and compassionately restores them with his sidelong glance. Show several figures beginning to rise and breathe; the nectar-like mercy is conveyed through gesture, water, and expression only, with no rays or beams.
rows.candidate_status: Krishna face B−R 51; gopa skin patches R−B 146 and 124 remain orange-rust. Producer needs-fix; targeted independent re-review pending.

rows.scene: Three distinct adult cowherds rise in wonder at the bliss throughout their bodies, recognize Krishna’s act, and embrace him with natural, connected limbs. Keep the embrace readable and the hands visible only where they can be clearly drawn.
rows.candidate_status: Producer needs-fix after the retry cap: gopa face R−B 128, 143 and 203; exposed arms 139–145; Krishna face B−R 32 and 20. Embrace scene follows canonical text/caption although #7 photo is a flute scene; crowded hand digits are not individually clear. Independent review pending.

rows.scene: A small distinct herd of newly revived cows gathers around Krishna, gazing at him with joyful, moist eyes and open gentle mouths. Krishna remains the single clear youthful figure; keep each animal’s legs and head distinct.
rows.candidate_status: Producer needs-fix after the retry cap: Krishna face/arm B−R 30/37, below threshold. A faint forehead streak is ambiguous; hands are partly occluded by cow heads; lower framing cuts off legs and feet. Four cows surround Krishna; independent review pending.

rows.scene: A few distinct cowherds show gooseflesh and overwhelming joy, then bow at Krishna’s feet with reverent prayer. Keep Krishna’s smooth forehead bare as contracted, and make every visible open hand anatomically clear with a thumb plus four fingers.
rows.candidate_status: Producer needs-fix after the retry cap: gopa skin-only R−B samples 138–149; Krishna face/arm B−R 57/52. Raised hand shows thumb plus four fingers; foot toe tips are less distinct and need independent checking. Independent review pending.

rows.scene: A quiet devotional closing scene: Bhattathiri kneels before youthful Krishna, praying for protection and release from illness; two recovered cowherds stand nearby as beneficiaries of the same mercy. Krishna’s compassion is conveyed by a gentle sidelong gaze and an open blessing hand. No halo beams; fingers clear.
rows.candidate_status: Producer needs-fix after the retry cap: Bhattathiri face R−B 128; one gopa R−B 145 and the other 119. Krishna face/hand B−R 84/81. Bare forehead, simple low band, feather, Bhattathiri tuft and one five-toe foot inspected. Independent review pending.
